column1: # Invented names in the forms LinkedIn profiles use, one per line: the name,
# the part of the profile's link after /in/ or nothing, the first name a
# greeting uses and the last word of the family name. Empty where the name
# holds none for sure, ? where the test does not ask. See docs/names.md.
Prof. Dr. med. habil. Mara Beispiel
Prof. Dr.-Ing. Dr. h.c. Tom Testmann
# Known misses, not tested: a name inside a sentence, like "Yoga mit
# Mara", is read as "Yoga". A family name followed by a word of the
# business, like "Mara Beispiel Coaching", ends with that word.
